text: The key for place i is the carved letter at place a times i plus b, wrapping round 97. That covers every lag (the letter before, the one 10 back) and every mirror of the copper.
Each known letter, with its key, predicts its carved letter. Over 223,488 rules and 24 ways of using the table, the best still misses 6 of 24.
The message read backwards from a centre was tried as its own key too: the chain of forced letters breaks under every way of using the table.
